name: Piece of cake
example: The test was a piece of cake.

name: Spill the beans
example: Don't spill the beans about the surprise.

name: The icing on the cake
tamilMeaning: ஏற்கனவே நல்லதற்கு மேலாக இன்னும் சிறப்பாக இருப்பது
example: Winning the prize was the icing on the cake.
exampleTamil: பரிசு வென்றது ஏற்கனவே இருந்த மகிழ்ச்சியை இன்னும் அதிகப்படுத்தியது.

name: Cry over spilled milk
example: Don't cry over spilled milk.

name: Take it with a grain of salt
example: Take his advice with a grain of salt.

name: In a nutshell
example: In a nutshell, the plan worked.

name: Butter someone up
example: He's trying to butter up his boss.
exampleTamil: அவர் தனது மேலாளரைப் புகழ்ந்து ஆதாயம் தேடுகிறார்.

name: Cheesy
example: That joke was a bit cheesy.

name: Full of beans
example: The kids are full of beans today.

name: Bring home the bacon
example: She works hard to bring home the bacon.

name: Bad egg
example: Stay away from him. He's a bad egg.
exampleTamil: அவரிடமிருந்து விலகி இரு. அவர் நல்லவர் அல்ல.

name: Egg someone on
example: His friends egged him on.

name: Hot potato
example: The issue became a hot potato.

name: Cool as a cucumber
example: She stayed cool as a cucumber.

name: Have bigger fish to fry
example: I can't help now. I have bigger fish to fry.
exampleTamil: இப்போது என்னால் உதவ முடியாது. எனக்கு முக்கியமான வேலை இருக்கிறது.

name: Sell like hotcakes
example: The new phones are selling like hotcakes.

name: Not my cup of tea
example: Horror movies are not my cup of tea.

name: Sugarcoat
example: Don't sugarcoat the truth.

name: Food for thought
example: His speech gave us food for thought.
exampleTamil: அவரது பேச்சு நமக்கு சிந்திக்க வேண்டிய விஷயங்களை அளித்தது.

name: Have your cake and eat it too
tamilMeaning: இரண்டு முரண்பட்ட நன்மைகளையும் ஒரே நேரத்தில் எதிர்பார்
example: You can't have your cake and eat it too.
exampleTamil: எல்லா நன்மைகளையும் ஒரே நேரத்தில் பெற முடியாது.
